name: hud_ui_mgr_target_update_selected_progress_meter
description: HudUiMgrTarget::UpdateSelectedProgressMeter updates the selected sensor target meter from player or turret health, remaps the tracked slot screen point, applies replicate-mode scaling, clamps the health ratio, updates meter fill points, invalidates, and toggles meter visibility.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4124b0 validates clearSelectedTrack clearing g_HudUiMgrSensorTrackedProgressSlot, HUD/objective/slot early gates, player and turret health source branches, zero-health hide call, zClipAlt::RemapPointXYInPlace rejection gate, replicate-mode doubling of slot screenX/screenY, health ratio clamping to [0, 1], ceil(fillPixelsMax * ratio), updating meter points 0 and 3, invalidating the meter, and final visible-on call.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4124b0 has no function or address tags in the current database; the x87 status-bit comparisons remain a known readability limitation but match the authored clamp behavior.
The native smoke covers the turret health path with replicate scaling and meter invalidation, the player health path with high-ratio clamping, and the clearSelectedTrack global clear path.
